div.head: II Cn 15
div.ab: And on Dæna lage he ah fihtewite ⁊ fyrdwita, gryðbryce ⁊ hamsocne, butan he hwæne ðe furður gemæðrian wylle.
And on Dena lage he ah fyhtwite ⁊ fyrdwite, griðbryce ⁊ hamsocne, buton he hwæne furðor gemeðrian wille.

In Denalaga habet rex fyhtþitan (id est forisfactum pugne) et fyrdþite (id est forisfacturam expeditionis), griþbrece (id est infractionem pacis) et hámsocnam (id est inuasionem mansionis), si non aliquem specialius honorauerit.
⁊ on Dena lage hé ah fihtwite ⁊ fyrdwita, griðbryce ⁊ hamsocne, butan he hwǽne furðor gemæðrian wylle.
And on Dæna lage he ah fihtewita and fyrdwita, gryðbryce and hamsocne, butan he hwæne ðe furður gemæðrian wylle.

Und im Dänen-Rechtsgebiet hat er [der König, vorbehalten] die Strafe(n G) für blutiges Fechten (Münzfälschung Inst.) und Strafe(n G B?) für Landwehr[versäumniss], den Bruch [königlichen] Sonderschutzes und [gesetzwidrige] Heimsuchung, es sei denn, er wolle jemanden (um so G) weiter [durch Jurisdictionsgewährung auch über diese Verbrechen] ehren.

And in the Danelaw he [the king] has [reserved] the fine for fighting (false coining, Inst.) and the fine for [neglect of] military service, breach of [the king's] protection and [unlawful] attack on a house, unless he wishes to honour someone further [by granting jurisdiction over these crimes too].

And in the Danelaw he has the receipt of fines for fighting, neglect of military service, breach of the peace and attacks upon people's houses, unless he desires specially to honour anyone [by granting him these dues].
And in the Danelaw he possesses the fine for fighting and that for neglecting military service, griðbryce (breach of the peace) and hamsocn unless he wishes to honour anyone further.
And in the Danelaw the king is entitled to the fines for fighting and shirking military service, breaching the peace and home invasion, unless he wishes to specially privilege someone.
div.note: The other MSS' ‘fihtwite’ is better than G's ‘fihtewita’ (but compare II Em 3). Quadr.'s þ = wynn.
